description: NaSm₉Si₆(SO₁₂)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.94 Å. There are five inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.74 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.76 Å. In the third Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.81 Å. In the fourth Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two S and six O atoms. There is one shorter (2.94 Å) and one longer (2.97 Å) Sm-S bond length. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-3.07 Å. In the fifth Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two S and five O atoms. Both Sm-S bond lengths are 2.98 Å. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.64 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to six Sm atoms to form face-sharing SSm₆ octahedra. In the second S site, S is bonded to six Sm atoms to form face-sharing SSm₆ octahedra. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Sm and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sm, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Sm and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Sm and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sm, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sm, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sm and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Sm and one Si atom.
